content.short: Greenlane Holdings is a Berachain-focused digital asset treasury strategy participating in the Proof of Liquidity.
content.description:
Greenlane Holdings is a Nasdaq-listed company that has transitioned into a Berachain-focused digital asset treasury strategy. By acquiring BERA tokens and participating in Berachain’s Proof of Liquidity ecosystem, the company serves as a publicly traded proxy for exposure to the network. This pivot allows investors to gain access to the growth of the Berachain ecosystem through a regulated financial instrument.

The company leverages its capital to provide liquidity and support the Berachain protocol. This approach bridges the gap between traditional equity markets and decentralized finance, offering a unique value proposition. Greenlane is committed to driving value by integrating with cutting-edge blockchain infrastructure.
